nameJa: ライブ コンサート
headline: Fullscreen. / Live Chat.
prompt:
Edit this existing concert editorial promotional tile. Preserve the saturated cobalt and inky black night atmosphere, warm vermilion glow on the left crowd, anonymous concert crowd silhouettes, diagonal stage lights, subtle tactile grain, and the single translucent chat overlay with composer lower-right. Keep this conceptual campaign image's art direction, do not replace it with generic corporate imagery.
Change the main large cream-colored headline completely. Delete "Stay in" and "the moment." and replace with EXACTLY:
first line: "Fullscreen."
second line: "Live Chat."
Important: "Fullscreen" is ONE unbroken word, not "Full Screen". Spell F u l l s c r e e n correctly, then period. "Live Chat." has capital L and C and one space before Chat, then period. Both required phrases must be the prominent main headline and clearly readable even at220x140thumbnail size. Keep the beautiful heavy sans-serif typography, strong hierarchy, generous margin and all letters safely inside canvas. They should dominate the upper-left while still letting the concert lighting breathe.
Preserve bottom-left small brand "LIVE CHAT FULLSCREEN". Preserve exactly the three UI messages "WHAT A SHOW", "Encore!", "Turn it up!" and input field "Say something..." with paper-plane send icon. No new copy or badges.
Canvas must stay a chunky11:7 landscape rectangle, width-to-height1.5714, requested1760x1120pixels. Never return a panoramic2.5:1 banner. Recompose subtly for fit if necessary, never stretch or crop typography. No real identifiable performer, logos, physical screen, gaming room, cars, glossy3D or watermarks. This is illustrative promotional UI, not a real product screenshot.
conceptNote: 青と朱色のライブ会場に、白い大きなFullscreen・Live Chatと半透明のチャット入力欄を重ねる。
